credits.title: Kaamelott: The Second Chapter (Part II)
credits.overview: Third and final film in the Kaamelott franchise.

credits.title: Kaamelott: The Second Chapter (Part I)
credits.overview: After reclaiming Kaamelott from Lancelot's tyrannical rule, Arthur spares his life, defying Celtic gods. Knights must prove themselves for Table Round seats while Arthur faces new threats as king.

credits.title: Kaamelott: The First Chapter
credits.overview: Hidden in Rome, King Arthur is planning his return to oppose the army of his former friend Lancelot.

credits.title: Public Friends
credits.overview: In order to make his little sick brother's dream come true, Leo and his best mates organize a fake score...but on the d day, they make a mistake and the fake score becomes a real hold up.Here starts the extraordinary adventure of PUBLIC Amis.

credits.title: I'm Going Home To Mum
credits.overview: Unemployed and separated from his wife, François has no choice but to return to live with his mother. To explain his return to the family home at the age of 40, he invents a job at a local firm. But living together becomes complicated.

credits.title: Adriana et moi
credits.overview: A modest gardener from Châtelet les Halles falls in love with the star Adriana Karembeu. But their relationship will be fraught with pitfalls.

credits.title: Dies irae
credits.overview: Pilot episode of the French comedy series "Kaamelott".
